items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: Well his father was a cellist and saxophone player with me at WINS at the time.

ctx.x: Yeah. You’ve heard of Ron Aldridge? He’s a famous dentist and a great jazz clarinet player? Ron Aldridge. He plays very much like Buddy DeFranco. Well his father was a cellist and saxophone player with me at WINS at the time.
